revenue_rule: payment_pending is not revenue; count 19 EUR only after manual payment confirmation

improvement.before: Checkout generated a payment-pending order and mailto link, but buyer/order proof was trapped on the page and the production builder handoff was not explicit.
improvement.after: Checkout now exposes Copy order JSON, Download order JSON, Track order and Open builder with this order. The generated proof includes production.builderUrl, requiredInputs and doNotStartBefore=payment_confirmed. Video builder now reads checkout URL params, pre-fills brand/headline/subline/CTA and displays the checkout order ID handoff banner.

regression_evidence.expected: brand, contact, product, ctaText and photoCount remain required; invalid photo count outside 1-12 is blocked
after valid submit, page shows copy/download proof controls and stores qpvLastCheckoutOrder in localStorage
builder link is generated with orderId, brand, headline, subline and cta params; builder pre-fills those fields and shows handoff banner
only checkout.html and video-maker.html changed in the product ship commits before QA proof

rejected_weak_patterns: No summaries, staffing plans, policies, idea lists or audits counted as progress
No fake revenue counted from payment-pending orders
No payment request without exportable order proof
No production start before payment confirmation
No buyer data lost between checkout and builder
